definitions.explanation: Having an even surface without roughness or bumps. Often describes texture.
Moving or proceeding without difficulties or interruptions. Used for speech, movements, or processes.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんの{肌|はだ}は{滑|なめ}らかだ。
このクリームを{塗|ぬ}ると{肌|はだ}が{滑|なめ}らかになる。
examples.english: This cream makes your skin smooth.

examples.japanese: {滑|なめ}らかな{表面|ひょうめん}に{仕上|しあ}げた。
examples.english: I finished it with a smooth surface.

examples.japanese: {滑|なめ}らかな{動|うご}きで{踊|おど}る。
{会議|かいぎ}は{滑|なめ}らかに{進|すす}んだ。
{彼女|かのじょ}の{英語|えいご}は{滑|なめ}らかで{聞|き}きやすい。
examples.english: Her English is fluent and easy to listen to.

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverb: {滑|なめ}らかに (smoothly)
・Noun: {滑|なめ}らかさ (smoothness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{滑|なめ}らかな{肌|はだ} (smooth skin)
・{滑|なめ}らかな{口調|くちょう} (smooth tone of voice)
・{滑|なめ}らかに{進|すす}む (proceed smoothly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・すべすべ - smooth to the touch (often for skin)
・つるつる - slippery smooth (can imply too slippery)
・{滑|なめ}らか is more literary and can describe both texture and abstract smoothness.
